title: LAN Chile 1069
summary: LAN Chile Flight 1069 was cleared for a VOR A approach to Puerto Williams on runway 26, but the captain decided to perform a direct approach to runway 08. The aircraft touched down 427 meters from the runway threshold at 112 knots on a wet runway with a negative slope and little braking action. The aircraft was unable to stop and overran the runway into the Beagle Channel. The investigation determined the probable cause was poor planning in changing runways and misapplication of the landing procedure.
probable_cause: The probable cause was a failure of good planning made by the pilot during the approach when he decided to change runway and misapplication of the landing procedure. The weather conditions, negative slope, wet runway, wind and little braking action led to the overrun of the runway.
